description.value: Re-Buy-Cycle Shop is a bicycle recycling and repair hub serving the greater Victoria area, specializing in the sale of quality pre-owned bikes across a wide range of styles including mountain, road, BMX, recumbent, and hybrid. Founded in 2016 with a strong community focus, the shop accepts donations of used bikes and components and runs a free children's bike exchange program. A touring cyclist stopping in would find a full repair service, a broad inventory of used parts sourced through a Vancouver wholesaler, and staff known for friendly, hands-on service.
